lines.en: label halloweenfive15:
scene clearnightsky
Even if your attention is split between several places and several times right now, it’s important to remember how  everything is connected — but I’m not talking about butterflies.
lines.zh: 即便此刻你的注意力被分散在好几个地方、好几个时间点上，重要的是要记住一切是如何相连的——不过我说的不是蝴蝶。

lines.en: Because it isn’t what comes after the caterpillar that matters in the long run, it’s the ones who chronicle their actions and stages of development. Who give them names or press their bodies into rectangular frames.
lines.zh: 因为从长远来看，重要的不是毛毛虫之后变成什么，而是那些记录它们行为与发育阶段的人。那些给它们命名、把它们的躯体压进矩形框里的人。

lines.en: And while all living things carry some level of importance, specifically that which can be held by wings, we often overestimate just what those wings are capable of.
lines.zh: 虽说一切生灵都有某种程度的重要性，尤其是那能被翅膀承载的重要性，但我们常常高估了那些翅膀究竟能做些什么。

lines.en: If such a small amount of flapping can tear a city to shreds, I wonder why those wings never flapped until something compelled them to.
lines.zh: 如果如此微弱的振翅就能把一座城市撕成碎片，我倒想知道，为什么那些翅膀在受到某种驱使之前从不扇动。

lines.en: You can talk about what affects what all day long. You can sit on your throne with a roll of red tape, then cover your eyes so all you’ll see is that you’ve always been right.
lines.zh: 你可以整日高谈什么影响什么。你可以坐在王座上，手里攥着一卷红胶带，然后蒙住自己的眼睛，好让你眼中所见只剩“我一直都是对的”。

lines.en: You can make {i}any{/i} puzzle piece fit if you cut it or mold it into what’s meant to be there. You can do {i}anything{/i} you set your mind to.
lines.zh: 只要你把它切割或塑造成该有的形状，你就能让{i}任何{/i}一块拼图严丝合缝。只要你下定决心，你{i}什么{/i}都能做到。

lines.en: But the truth is this-
lines.zh: 但真相是这样的——

lines.en: Both triumph and failure are scripted. Because if {i}you{/i} can do anything, {i}anyone{/i} can do anything. Any{i}thing{/i} can do anything. And this creates a world of limitless possibilities.
lines.zh: 成功与失败都是被写好的。因为既然{i}你{/i}能做任何事，那么{i}任何人{/i}都能做任何事。任何{i}事物{/i}都能做任何事。而这便创造出一个可能性无穷的世界。

lines.en: It creates an {i}infinite{/i} amount of worlds where different things are happening. Some wild by comparison, some tame. But again, it’s never the butterfly that serves as the bringer of destruction.
lines.zh: 它创造出{i}无限{/i}多个正在发生不同事情的世界。相比之下，有的狂野，有的温顺。但再说一次，带来毁灭的从来都不是蝴蝶。

lines.en: It’s the library of outcomes. That hall of impossible possibilities, where each door opens to a new world with new familiarities, accompanied by little more than happenstance and minute changes that, you guessed it-
lines.zh: 是那座结果的图书馆。那座不可能之可能性的殿堂，每一扇门都通向一个新的世界，带着新的熟悉感，伴随的不过是偶发事件与微小的变动——你猜对了——

lines.en: Lack the power to ever destroy anything at all.
lines.zh: 永远不具备摧毁任何东西的力量。

lines.en: If something breaks here, somewhere else it won’t.
lines.zh: 如果有什么在这里碎了，在别处它就不会碎。

lines.en: So if you just so happen to find yourself in a place where things don’t go the way you like, that’s okay.
lines.zh: 所以如果你碰巧发现自己身处一个事事都不顺你心的地方，那也没关系。

lines.en: Because there’s somewhere out there where they {i}will.{/i}
lines.zh: 因为在某个地方，它们{i}会{/i}顺你的心。

lines.en: You just need to figure out how to get there.
lines.zh: 你只需要弄明白怎么到那儿去。

lines.en: You know...
lines.zh: 你知道吗……

lines.en: Maybe God is just the thought of God.
lines.zh: 也许神只是“神”这个念头。

lines.en: It’s powerful enough.
lines.zh: 它已经足够强大了。

lines.en: It drives us to do insane things — it drives us to {i}this.{/i} And so much has happened that I can barely tell what {i}this{/i} is anymore.
lines.zh: 它驱使我们做出疯狂的事——它把我们驱赶到了{i}这一步{/i}。发生了太多事，我几乎已经说不清{i}这{/i}到底是什么了。

lines.en: All I know is that there is beauty to be found in everything.
lines.zh: 我只知道，万物之中都有美可寻。

lines.en: You just need to look closer.
lines.zh: 你只需要凑近一点看。

lines.en: scene okayitsgametimeagain1
scene okayitsgametimeagain2
: You really went overboard this time, Ami. I seriously can’t believe you just carved a hole into Nodoka’s abdomen with the same knife we were using to cut up the roast Ayane’s butler made.
lines.zh: : 这次你真的玩过头了，Ami。我真不敢相信，你居然用我们切 Ayane 家管家烤的那块肉的同一把刀，在 Nodoka 的肚子上捅了个洞。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Mom. I promise it won’t happen again.
lines.zh: : 对不起，妈妈。我保证不会有下次了。

lines.en: : Ugghhhh {i}fine.{/i} I’ll let you off with a warning {i}this{/i} time. But at least let your father penetrate the next girl {i}before{/i} you start stabbing her to death.
lines.zh: : 呃啊啊啊，{i}好吧{/i}。{i}这次{/i}我就警告一下放你一马。但下次至少让你爸爸{i}先{/i}插进下一个女孩，你再开始把她捅死。

lines.en: scene okayitsgametimeagain3
: Hahahahahahaha!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！

lines.en: scene okayitsgametimeagain4
: Sorry for the mess, Dad. I told myself I’d be a good girl for your sake tonight, but I guess I really fudged {i}that{/i} up, huh?
lines.zh: : 抱歉弄得一团糟，爸爸。我本来跟自己说今晚为了你要当个乖女孩的，不过看来我{i}搞砸了{/i}呢？

lines.en: : What made you snap anyway, Ami? Was it just the fact that Nodoka hugged your daddy out of nowhere that sent you over the edge?
lines.zh: : 说起来，你到底为什么突然发作啊，Ami？就因为 Nodoka 冷不丁抱了你爸爸一下，你就失控了？

lines.en: scene okayitsgametimeagain5
: Soooooomething like that~
lines.zh: : 差……差不多就是这样～

lines.en: : Well, whatever the case, don’t let it happen again! Cause I’m sure you know what needs to happen {i}now{/i} to clean up after your mess, right?
lines.zh: : 好吧，不管怎样，别再犯了！因为你肯定知道{i}现在{/i}该怎么收拾你留下的烂摊子，对吧？

lines.en: scene okayitsgametimeagain6
: Awwww man! But I was really looking forward to Christmas this year!
lines.zh: : 呜哇啊啊！可是我今年超期待圣诞节的啊！

lines.en: : Well, you’ll just have to look forward to it {i}next{/i} year instead. Because {b}SANTA{/b} is always watching, Ami. And {b}SANTA{/b} knows when you’ve been naughty or nice.
lines.zh: : 那你就只能等明年再期待了。因为{b}圣诞老人{/b}一直在看着呢，Ami。而且{b}圣诞老人{/b}知道你乖不乖。

lines.en: scene okayitsgametimeagain7
: Hey, you don’t think Daddy’s going to be like that for the rest of the night, do you? I was hoping the three of us could go trick-or-treating again this year.
lines.zh: : 嘿，你觉得爸爸不会一整晚都那样吧？我还指望今年我们三个能再去要一次糖果呢。

lines.en: : I’m not sure, Ami. He {i}did{/i} just see something pretty horrific. But I’m also assuming it’s not the first time he’s seen a dead body if what he was telling me earlier was actually true.
lines.zh: : 我不确定，Ami。他刚{i}确实{/i}看到了相当可怕的东西。不过如果他之前跟我说的那些是真的，我猜这也不是他第一次看见尸体了。

lines.en: : I don’t really get it. But if I made you sad, Daddy, I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 我不太明白。不过如果我让你难过了，爸爸，对不起。

lines.en: scene okayitsgametimeagain8
: Oh! I’ve got an idea, though! Maybe I could give you a blowjob to help!
lines.zh: : 哦！不过我有个主意！也许我可以帮你口交，让你好受点！

lines.en: scene okayitsgametimeagain9

: Ooooh! Tempting, isn’t it Aki-kun? Blowjobs don’t count as sex, you know. Surely you can still “love” your daughter by your own definition if you let her suck on your penis for a little while, right?
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦！很诱人吧，Aki 君？口交又不算做爱，你知道的。按你自己的定义，只要让她含一会儿你的鸡巴，你照样可以“爱”你的女儿，对吧？

lines.en: : Oh, but maybe you want to get dressed first. I don’t want Ami getting her hoodie all messy. It’s the only change of clothes I packed.
lines.zh: : 哦，不过你可能想先穿上衣服。我可不想让 Ami 把她的连帽衫弄脏。我就只带了这一件换洗衣服。

lines.en: scene okayitsgametimeagain10
: It’s fine, Mom. We should probably get going soon anyway. The cops could be here any minute.
lines.zh: : 没事的，妈妈。反正我们也该走了。警察随时都可能到。

lines.en: scene okayitsgametimeagain11
: Are you okay to drive, Aki-kun? Because I know you hate it when {i}I{/i} do, but you seem pretty out of it right now. And I don’t want to make you do anything you’re uncomfortable with.
lines.zh: : 你能开车吗，Aki 君？我知道你不喜欢{i}我{/i}开，可你现在看起来魂不守舍的。我不想逼你做任何让你不舒服的事。

lines.en: : Ah! {i}Sometimes, forcing people to do things they're not comfortable with is the best way to move them forward.{/i}
lines.zh: : 啊！{i}有时候，逼人去做他们不舒服的事，反而是推动他们前进的最好办法。{/i}

lines.en: scene okayitsgametimeagain12
: Ooooh! Where’d you hear {i}that{/i} one, lightning bug?
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦！你从哪儿听来{i}这句话{/i}的，小萤火虫？

lines.en: : Mmmm...I forget!
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯……我忘了！

lines.en: : Well, I guess it doesn’t really matter. A phrase is a phrase is a phrase. If you’ve heard one, you’ve heard them all.
lines.zh: : 好吧，我想也不重要。一句话就是一句话就是一句话。听过一句，就等于听过全部了。

lines.en: : Now, how about we go stop for ice cream? We should have time for that before the grand finale, right?
lines.zh: : 那么，我们顺便去吃个冰淇淋怎么样？在压轴大戏之前应该还来得及，对吧？

lines.en: : Grand...finale?...
lines.zh: : 压轴……大戏？……

lines.en: scene okayitsgametimeagain13
: Oh, good! Daddy’s rejoined us. I was beginning to think we’d need to get the jar out again.
lines.zh: : 哦，太好了！爸爸归队了。我刚才还在想，是不是又得把罐子拿出来了。

lines.en: : Both of you...
lines.zh: : 你们两个……

lines.en: : Are fucking insane...
lines.zh: : 都他妈是疯子……

lines.en: scene okayitsgametimeagain14
: I mean, yeah. Was that not obvious when I coerced a teenage girl into riding you like a bucking bronco an hour or two ago?
lines.zh: : 就是说啊，对。难道我一两个小时前逼一个少女像骑烈马一样骑在你身上的时候，还不够明显吗？

lines.en: scene okayitsgametimeagain8
: We’re not “insane,” Daddy. We just really, really love you! Which is exactly why we keep trying to create safe spaces for you.
lines.zh: : 我们不是“疯子”，爸爸。我们只是真的、真的很爱你！这正是我们一直想为你营造安全空间的原因。

lines.en: : But it’s okay! Because even if I accidentally ruined this one, I’m sure there’s another one waiting for you just around the bend.
lines.zh: : 不过没关系！因为就算我不小心毁掉了这一个，我敢肯定拐弯过去还有另一个在等你。

lines.en: scene okayitsgametimeagain9
: Now, put {i}that{/i} in your pipe and smoke it.
lines.zh: : 好了，把{i}这句话{/i}塞进你的烟斗里抽了吧。

lines.en: scene okayitsgametimeagain15
: AAAGGGGGHHH!!! I can’t believe that just happened! What the fuck, Ami?!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊！！！我真不敢相信刚刚发生了那种事！搞什么鬼啊，Ami？！

lines.en: : Heehee! You came so many times I’m surprised you’re still awake!
lines.zh: : 嘻嘻！你去了那么多次，我都很意外你居然还醒着！

lines.en: scene okayitsgametimeagain16
: And I just...went along with it...even after you took off the shackles...
lines.zh: : 而我居然……就这么顺着来了……甚至在你把镣铐解开之后……

lines.en: : Yeah, cause you’re a slutty lil’ slut who cums after like five seconds. But don’t feel bad, Maya. I’ve got like, kadrillions of years worth of experience and you’re just a cute little baby bird right now!
lines.zh: : 对啊，因为你就是个五秒就高潮的小骚货。不过别难过，Maya。我可是有……几千万亿年的经验，你现在还只是一只可爱的小雏鸟呢！

lines.en: scene okayitsgametimeagain17
: I got so many good pictures too. This’ll make capturing Sensei’s heart like fifty times easier.
lines.zh: : 我还拍到了好多好照片。这样一来，拿下 Sensei 的心就容易五十倍了。

lines.en: : This is all a part of the plan...and if I was tied to a chair and sexually abused for several hours, it’s because I {i}had{/i} to be in order to be reunited with Akira...
lines.zh: : 这都是计划的一部分……如果说我被绑在椅子上、被性侵了几个小时，那也是为了能和 Akira 重逢而{i}必须{/i}承受的……

lines.en: : It’s not abuse if you like iiiiit~
lines.zh: : 只要你自己喜欢，那就不算性侵呀～

lines.en: scene okayitsgametimeagain18
: Yes it is, you fucking psychopath! How did you even get me here?!
lines.zh: : 就是算，你这个该死的疯子！你到底是怎么把我弄到这里来的？！

lines.en: : I already told you. You blacked out and I carried you here.
lines.zh: : 我不是说了吗。你昏过去了，我把你抱过来的。

lines.en: : Yes, that’s what you {i}said!{/i} But of course I’m not going to believe that when you’re only an inch or two taller than me and probably just as strong!
lines.zh: : 对，你是这么{i}说的{/i}！可你也就比我高一两英寸，力气大概也差不多，我当然不会信啊！

lines.en: : Well, I don’t know what you want me to say. It’s not like I’m just going to reveal {i}all{/i} of my secrets to you just because you’re probably going to be deleted in a few minutes. Some secrets need to {i}stay{/i} secrets.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我不知道你想让我说什么。我也不可能因为你可能几分钟后就要被删除，就把我{i}所有{/i}的秘密都抖出来吧。有些秘密就该{i}永远是{/i}秘密。

lines.en: scene okayitsgametimeagain19
: What do you mean “deleted?”
lines.zh: : “删除”是什么意思？

lines.en: : The world’s starting over again, so it’s time for Maya to go bye-bye. This one’s not meant to be here.
lines.zh: : 世界又要重新开始了，所以 Maya 该说拜拜了。这一个本来就不该在这儿。

lines.en: : How...How do you know that, though? Are you in control of this stuff?
lines.zh: : 可……可你是怎么知道的？这事儿是你在控制吗？

lines.en: scene okayitsgametimeagain20
: God, I {i}wish.{/i} I don’t control anything. I’m just good at stuff. But you’re an idiot, so you’re probably going to die now. Oh well.
lines.zh: : 天啊，我也{i}希望{/i}是。我什么都控制不了。我只是擅长而已。但你是白痴，所以你现在大概要死了。算了。

lines.en: : And there’s...nothing you can do to make me stay?
lines.zh: : 就……没有别的办法能让我留下吗？

lines.en: scene okayitsgametimeagain21
: Weren’t you just bitching like {i}three{/i} seconds ago about how I “sexually abused” you? And now you want to {i}stay{/i} with-
lines.zh: : 你{i}三{/i}秒前不是还在抱怨我“性侵”你吗？现在又想{i}留下来{/i}——

lines.en: scene okayitsgametimeagain22
: Oh. Yeah, on second thought, that makes sense.
lines.zh: : 哦。对，再想想，这就说得通了。

lines.en: : I don’t...count what happened between Sensei and me as abuse...
lines.zh: : 我不……不把 Sensei 和我之间发生的事算作性侵……

lines.en: scene okayitsgametimeagain23
: Yeah, because you’re a lovestruck little bimbo who’s devoted her life to chasing after the only dick she’s ever felt inside of her.
lines.zh: : 对啊，因为你就是个被爱情冲昏头的小蠢货，把一辈子都用来追那根唯一进过你身体的鸡巴。

lines.en: : So are you, Ami...
lines.zh: : 你也是这样啊，Ami……

lines.en: : We’re the same and you know it.
lines.zh: : 我们是一样的，你心里清楚。

lines.en: : {i}Noooo.{/i} I’ve lived through unspeakable trauma. How about you? Where do {i}you{/i} come from, Maya?
lines.zh: : {i}不——不是。{/i}我经历过难以言说的创伤。你呢？{i}你{/i}从哪儿来，Maya？

lines.en: : What do you mean where do I come from? I-
lines.zh: : 我“从哪儿来”是什么意思？我——

lines.en: scene okayitsgametimeagain24
: Wait...
lines.zh: : 等等……

lines.en: : I...I don’t...
lines.zh: : 我……我不知道……

lines.en: : There’s no use in trying to remember.
lines.zh: : 想起来也没用。

lines.en: : You haven’t known for as long as we’ve been friends. And we’ve been friends for a reaaaaaally long time.
lines.zh: : 从我们成为朋友起，你就一直不知道。而我们做朋友已经做了非——常久的时间了。

lines.en: : But...how can I not...
lines.zh: : 可……我怎么会不……

lines.en: : Because you were never meant to be here at all. You’re an accident. Unwanted. And I’ve got all I’ve wanted out of you, so either shut up and die quietly or...
lines.zh: : 因为你根本就不该存在。你是个意外。没人要的东西。我想从你身上得到的已经都得到了，所以要么闭嘴安静地去死，要么……

lines.en: : Actually, that’s it. Just shut up and die quietly. Kaythanksbye.
lines.zh: : 其实就这样。闭嘴，安静地去死。谢啦拜。

lines.en: : What’s going to happen next?...
lines.zh: : 接下来会发生什么？……

lines.en: : Are {i}you{/i} going to do it?...
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}会动手吗？……

lines.en: : I might have to if you don’t shut your fucking mouth, jeez.
lines.zh: : 你要是再不闭上你那张臭嘴，我可能真得动手了，天啊。

lines.en: : But no.
lines.zh: : 不过不会的。

lines.en: scene okayitsgametimeagain25
: {i}The sky will take care of that for me.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}天空会替我搞定的。{/i}

lines.en: : When the fuck did the moon get so much more...{i}moony?{/i}
lines.zh: : 月亮什么时候变得这么……{i}月亮了？{/i}

lines.en: : You’ve never noticed that before? It just kind of happens sometimes.
lines.zh: : 你以前从没注意过？这种情况偶尔就会发生。

lines.en: : Then, in a few minutes once the reset starts, the sky will get all multicolored and pretty. It’s actually really nice if you can separate yourself from the crippling fear of not knowing what comes next.
lines.zh: : 然后，等几分钟后重置开始，天空会变得五彩缤纷，很漂亮。其实只要你把“不知道接下来会发生什么”的那种让人瘫软的恐惧剥离掉，那景色真的很美。

lines.en: : I don’t know...I might be having second thoughts about this. Will shit start lookin’ normal again if I head back to the hotel now?
lines.zh: : 我不知道……我可能有点动摇了。如果我现在回酒店，这些东西会恢复正常吗？

lines.en: : Probably not. I think you’re basically screwed now. So you either come with me and we face this together, or you head home to find that everyone you know has essentially vanished.
lines.zh: : 大概不会。我觉得你现在基本上完了。所以你要么跟我走，我们一起面对；要么你回家，然后发现你认识的每个人都基本上消失了。

lines.en: scene okayitsgametimeagain26
: The fuck you mean “vanished?”
lines.zh: : “消失”是什么意思？

lines.en: : I wish I knew. The only real experience I have with it is when Maya disappeared once, but...something about Sensei being nearby sort of pulled her back into existence.
lines.zh: : 我也希望我知道。我唯一一次真正经历这种事，是有一次 Maya 消失了，但……Sensei 就在附近这一点，似乎把她重新拉回了存在之中。

lines.en: : Maybe it was a coincidence. Maybe he can do that with {i}everyone{/i} if he knows where they are. But it’s not like we can find out here when {i}this{/i} Sensei isn’t ours.
